hooks.command: cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" || exit 0; if [ -n "$(git status --porcelain 2>/dev/null)" ] || [ "$(git rev-list --count @{u}..HEAD 2>/dev/null || echo 0)" -gt 0 ]; then echo '{"systemMessage": "Uncommitted or unpushed changes in the repo - record them in git/GitHub before wrapping up."}'; fi
